description: Test Genie exposes `workflow` as the canonical delegated phase and keeps `playbooks` as migration-only aliasing.

requirements.title: Register Canonical Delegated Workflow Phase
requirements.description: Test Genie must register a canonical `workflow` phase backed by workflow-health via the generic validation-provider adapter, include execution by default for runtime workflows, and expose workflow metadata in presets, docs, schemas, and CLI phase validation.

validation.notes: Phase catalog guard tests assert `workflow` uses source `validation-provider`, provider scenario `workflow-health`, execution enabled, and no active native runner entry.

requirements.title: Alias Deprecated Playbooks Inputs
requirements.description: Test Genie must accept `playbooks` only as a documented deprecated alias that routes to `workflow`, emits deprecation guidance, and never appears as the final canonical catalog phase.

validation.notes: `test-genie execute <scenario> --phases playbooks` routes to workflow with a deprecation warning; `--phases workflow` is the documented path.

title: Test Genie workflow migration
